# Grid & Dot

> Extended expertise recruitment agency based in London, UK. We curate digital specialists — not CVs — for product strategy, data architecture, delivery, and digital transformation teams.

## About

Grid & Dot is a London-based talent curation agency. We match curated digital specialists to companies' culture, workflows, and goals. Our focus is quality over volume, long-term fit, and ongoing support.

## Services

- **Talent Acquisition** — Finding the right digital specialists for your team.
- **HR Consulting** — Strategic advice for your HR needs.
- **Career Coaching** — Helping candidates reach their potential.
- **Extended Expertise** — Curated specialists in product strategy, data architecture, delivery, UX/design, and content.

## Expertise Areas

- Product Strategy
- Data Architecture
- Delivery & Agile
- UX & Design
- Content Strategy
- Digital Transformation

## Regions Served

- United Kingdom (HQ: London)
- EMEA
- APAC
